notes: Vertex: f32 x3 position, i8 x4 normal x127 (4th byte: untextured face's alpha), f32 x2 uv, u16 texture ((array << 12) | layer, 0xFFFF untextured), u16 untextured face's colour as RGB565, u32 zero. Indices follow the vertices (byte offset indexOffset), relative to each LOD's baseVertex. Positions are in world axes and units; swapping y and z mirrors the model, so triangle winding is reversed: draw both sides. lodDistances: the header's thresholds are squared distances in object units, written as sqrt(t) / 128 world units; null = no limit.
